item_reviews.comment: Directly supported by T3 matched medians, 29.4 vs 47.8 ms; the central answer on speed.
T3 supports higher throughput and lower p90 latency for Gossamer-Seg.
Supported by T1 and S1: a 0.4-point difference that is not significant. The 'did not incur lower' wording is acceptable, and the evidence shows no detectable cost.
T5 values match: higher on car, cyclist and pole; lower on pedestrian and vegetation. Per-class differences are small and untested.
T4 shows higher GFLOPs and parameters for Gossamer-Seg, despite the faster measured latency.
T2 and P1 show differing hardware, batch size, precision and accounting; the published figures are not comparable.
